in_marathi.name: Thapa
in_marathi.long_meaning: Thapa हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Thapa is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'thapati', which means 'protector' or 'guardian'. It is a unisex name with themes of strength, protection, and gentleness. In Hinduism, it is believed that the name carries spiritual significance and emotional traits such as courage, resilience, and nurturing.
